description: Test vectors for mail body normalisation text-v1 (lab/seeder/normalize.py, C++ W3.2). For each case, normalize(input) == normalized and sha256 is the lower-case hex SHA-256 of normalized encoded as UTF-8 without a BOM. Non-ASCII characters are written as JSON u-escapes so invisible ones (BOM, NBSP, combining marks) stay visible.
